title: Show the greeting history newest-first
body:
The greeting history is printed oldest-first, so the entry I care about most — the last one I made — is buried at the bottom of the block. Print the history in reverse instead, most recent line first.

Keep showing at most the same number of entries as today. Where the "и ещё N ранее." summary line belongs once the order is flipped, and what happens when the history is empty, are for the specification to settle.
